newPolicyRows.subject: Wirtschaftswissenschaften
newPolicyRows.rationale: Edition-bound decision for this retained BP2016 WBS source only: the official Gymnasium subject plan dated 23 March 2016 took effect on 1 August 2016 for the stated incoming cohorts and specifies its content standards in the combined Klassen 8/9/10 band. The 43 unchanged extracted source goals and their existing Klassen8-10 tags are treated as legacy G8-compatible source evidence. The current ministry timetable distinguishes WBS across G8 classes 8-10 (1, 1, 2 weekly hours) from the new G9 classes 8-11 (1, 1, 1, 1); these shared hour totals do not establish equal content or year placement. This policy introduces no new duration-specific learner-facing tree and does not certify current or incoming new-G9 WBS curriculum fidelity, a class-11 placement, a G9 source extraction, or runtime/view availability. Historic G9 model-school use of BP2016 is not denied, but no reviewed G9 placement is derived from this bounded retained extraction. Current G9 source/cohort qualification remains separate. All source competencies, original passage texts, source IDs, mappings, ordinary goals and course/projection roles remain unchanged.
